Diodes belong to a group of components called solid-state devices..
SOLID-STATE DEVICE - A solid-state device is an electronic device which operates by virtue of the movement of electrons within a solid piece of semiconductor material.
SOLID-STATE DEVICE - A solid-state device is an electronic device which operates by virtue of the movement of positive and negative charges within a solid piece of semiconductor material.
DEFINITION
Diodes belong to a group of components called solid-state devices.
Diodes are made from semiconductor materials that have the properties of conductors and insulators.
They can not be compared to resistors, capacitors, inductors or transformers.
